decisions.reason: As a door lever handle family that stays on the website across 2023 and 2024, it fits the firm's core architectural hardware knowledge and can likely be refined through existing design, certification and manufacturing capabilities rather than abandoned.

The multifunctional door lever handle is very close to the firm's established competence base and its move to a dedicated page in 2024 suggests the firm has learned how to position and develop it commercially.

Although it appears only as a mentioned product rather than a highlighted range, it remains within the firm's strongest knowledge domain, so management would more likely retain it as part of the coordinated portfolio unless overlap or weak demand becomes clear.

This award-winning door and window handle collection has the strongest visible market validation and is tightly aligned with the firm's design-led, system-based capabilities, making withdrawal within a year very unlikely.
